CHAPTER 5 - FEATS
Ramirez, the time mage, sprang into action to save his endangered ally. Summoning his mastery over temporal magic, he aimed to halt the peril in its tracks. Yet, in a peculiar twist of fate, a breach in the timeline caused a massive hourglass to materialize instead, shattering upon arrival and scattering sand throughout the scene. Now, Ramirez faced an unforeseen challenge: navigating the chaotic sands of time to rescue both his companion and repair the fabric of reality disrupted by his misstep. 
Feats represent specialized abilities that your character can acquire through experience, training, or natural talent. They enhance your character’s capabilities, provide new options for combat or roleplay, and can offer unique advantages in specific situations. Feats might grant entirely new abilities, improve existing ones, or unlock situational benefits that can set your character apart.
Many feats come with prerequisites that must be met before you can select them. These prerequisites might include skill ranks, specific ability scores, or proficiencies with certain weapons or tools. For instance, a feat might require proficiency with martial weapons or a minimum Dexterity score.
Feats allow you to shape your character’s development and focus, letting you specialize in areas or create a versatile adventurer. Each character begins with a number of feats based on their race and class, and you gain additional feats as you level up. Typically, you gain one feat at each career level, though some classes grant bonus feats at specific milestones, as detailed in Chapter 4.
By carefully selecting feats, you can expand your character’s tactical options, develop creative solutions to challenges, and unlock powerful synergies within your abilities. 
FEAT CATEGORIES 
Feats are divided into several different categories which are briefly explained here.
RACIAL FEATS 
Your characters race will allow you access to racial feats at 1st level, 5th level and then every 5 levels thereafter. Racial feat picks may be used to select racial feats and any favoured racial feats.
ARCHETYPE FEATS 
Archetype feats are a special type of class feat and may be selected only with class feat picks. Once you have selected an archetype feat, you must complete its progression requirements before you can select another. It is also important to be aware that some class feats might have an archetype as a trait, in which case you can select this feat if you already have the archetype feat. 
CLASS FEATS 
Your character will be able to select one class feat at 1st level. At 2nd level and then every 2 levels thereafter, you will be able to select another class feat for your character. Some classes may allow you to select additional class feats and this will be detailed in the class’s description. 
GENERAL FEATS 
General feats have no association with a class and usually affect skills and actions in some way. Your character will be able to select one general feat at 1st level. At 3rd level and then every 2 levels thereafter, you will be able to select another general feat for your character.
GRANTED FEATS 
You gain a number of specific feats from things such as race, background and classes which you do not have to expend a feat pick for. Feats granted in this way do not require you to meet their usual prerequisites.
FEAT SPECIFICS
There are several rules which govern how feats work and how they can be selected.
FEAT TRAITS 
Some feats will have traits which help how they work in play. Some feats will have traits that correspond to a specific race, archetype, class type or class. If a feat has such a trait, you must satisfy at least one of these traits. 
FEAT PREREQUISITES
Some feats will have prerequisites which must be fulfilled before the feat can be taken. 
FEAT REQUIREMENTS
Some feats will have requirements which determine a specific type of situation or action that must be present for the feat to be able to be used. 
Be aware that unless stated in its individual description, each feat may only be selected once.
FEAT VS FEATSometimes, two feats may directly oppose or contradict each other. When this is the case, this must be resolved as an Opposed Check using appropriate skills (GM discretion).FEAT VS FEATSometimes, two feats may directly oppose or contradict each other. When this is the case, this must be resolved as an Opposed Check using appropriate skills (GM discretion).
RACIAL FEATS
Each race has a selection of feats available to them. As long as you meet the prerequisites, you may select a racial feat at 1st level. At 5th level and then every 5 levels thereafter, you may select an additional racial feat.
AGELESS KNOWLEDGE
ASCENDAN ELF
You have amassed a wealth of practical knowledge and life experience throughout your years.
Prerequisites at least 100 years old
During your daily preparations, you can take time to contemplate and reflect upon the experiences and wisdom you have gained throughout your life experiences to gain a +2 racial skill bonus to one skill of your choice. This bonus lasts until your next daily preparations. 
AGELESS LANGUAGE
ASCENDAN ELF
You have dedicated considerable time to the study of languages throughout your life. 
Prerequisites at least 100 years old, Linguistics 2 ranks
During your daily preparation, you can immerse yourself in old memories and gain fluency in a common language or one other language that you have knowledge of. You may read, write and speak this language until your next daily preparations. 
AGELESS PATIENCE 
ASCENDAN ELF 
Your long years of existence have instilled in you a methodical approach to tasks, allowing you to work with meticulousness and precision.
Prerequisites Level 2
If you choose to spend double the usual amount of time in a skill check, you can benefit from a +2 racial bonus to it. Furthermore, you treat a blunder as a fumble and a fumble as a failure when making this check. 
ALTERED CANTRIP
HUMAN 
By exploring diverse magical traditions, you have adapted a spell to harmonize with your style of spellcasting. 
Prerequisites BSB +1
Choose a cantrip from a magical tradition other than your own and incorporate it into your repertoire as one of your cantrips. When you cast this cantrip, you wield it as if it were an inherent part of your own magical tradition, seamlessly blending its power with your unique spellcasting abilities. 
Be aware that this feat replaces one of your existing cantrips and does not add an additional one.
AMBITIOUS
HUMAN 
You were nurtured with a spirit of ambition, encouraging you to constantly strive for greatness and set your sights on the highest achievements. 
You gain any one class feat for which you meet the pre-requisites. You have the flexibility to choose this feat later during the character creation process, enabling you to determine which prerequisites you have met.

BEASTMAN

You have the blood of an animal within you. 
Prerequisites Level 1 only
How this has occurred is unknown, but it is likely that you have a lycanthrope in your ancestry. You gain Nightvision, or you gain Darkvision if your race already has Nightvision. In addition, you can select beastman racial feats. When you select this feat you must select an animal race as your lineage.
Your animal form is usually one selected from the common animal species native to your homeland. Subtle characteristics might include strange eyes, pointed ears, excessive body hair, a long nose, a long-forked tongue and just about anything else you can think of.

Tapping into your feral blood, you can shrug off pain and injury with uncanny endurance. 
Prerequisites Level 5, Con +2
Once per day, when you are reduced below half your HP, you may activate this feat as a free action to gain Fast Healing equal to your Constitution for 1 minute.
At 10th level and higher, you also gain resistance to bludgeoning, physical damage for the duration.

You can communicate with and understand animals that have a burrow Speed, such as badgers, moles, rabbits and squirrels. You can ask them questions, receive answers, and even use your Diplomacy skill to interact with them. The GM has the final say on which specific animals can be communicated with using this ability.

ELF

HAULING SHADOW

Your shadow serves as a hidden storage space. 
Prerequisites Level 10
You can use your shadow as a unique storage compartment by interacting with it. This process follows the usual rules for storing or retrieving an item from a stored location. Your shadow has a capacity of 10 lbs for storing objects, and these items do not contribute to the weight you are carrying. While stored in your shadow, the items retain their solidity but appear shadowy. Although they can be detected normally, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Conceal an Object (Stealth) checks when concealing the objects in your shadow, unless someone specifically checks your shadow for items.

HYBRID TRANSFORMATION
ALTERATION BEASTMAN CONCENTRATE MORPH 
Your connection to your bestial heritage allows you to shift between your humanoid and hybrid forms. While you typically walk the world in your humanoid guise—appearing as a member of your native race with subtle animalistic features—you can unleash your true potential by assuming a powerful Hybrid Form. 
Action 1 AP 
You gain the ability to shift into your Hybrid Form. In this form, your appearance merges traits of both your humanoid and beast forms. Your facial structure, limbs, posture, and even voice may take on features of your animal side, whether it’s the feathered crest of a raptor, the furred muzzle of a wolf, or the scaled eyes of a serpent.
While in Hybrid Form:
• You gain a bite unarmed Strike that reflects your animalistic nature (e.g., fangs for wolves, beak for birds, tusks for boars).
• This bite deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
• It is considered a brawling weapon for the purposes of effects and feats.
• You gain a natural base DR 1
You may return to your humanoid form as another 1 AP action. You may remain in Hybrid Form indefinitely but cannot disguise your nature while in it—others can clearly perceive your hybrid state.
At GM discretion, you may choose a different natural weapon reflective of your beast heritage (e.g., claws instead of a bite) when you take this feat.

LUCK FOR ALL
CHANCE HALFLING 
It would seem that your luck is contagious. 
Prerequisites Luck of the Small Folk
You possess the ability to influence the fortunes of those around you. When an ally within 30 feet of you fails a skill check or a saving throw, you can channel your luck to grant them a chance at redemption. Instead of rerolling your own failed check, you bestow upon your ally the opportunity to reroll their triggering check. It is important to note that your ally must abide by the outcome of this new roll, even if it proves less favourable than their initial attempt. 
Be aware that if you possess the Guiding Fortune feat, the effect that applies to attack rolls cannot be used in conjunction with Luck for All to benefit an ally.

SHADOW SENSE
GNOME KORNARGON
Your heritage is steeped in the art of illusion, and as such, detecting shadow magic comes naturally to you. 
You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and Will saves when dealing with shadow magic. Moreover, when utilizing Sense Magic (Power Manipulation) to detect active shadow magic, the penalty incurred is reduced to -5 instead of the usual -10.
SHADOWBORN AGILITY
KORNARGON 
Your body possesses a remarkable degree of flexibility, rivalling the nimbleness of your very own shadow. 
Prerequisites Level 5
When you Fumble a Squeeze (Acrobatics) check, you instead get a result of failure. Furthermore, when you roll a success on an Escape check, it is elevated to a Critical. In the event of a Critical, you have the option to Step up to 5 feet instead of simply Striding.
SHADOWY GUISE
KORNARGON
By weaving the shadowy energies around you, you can alter your visage, adopting a new guise that conceals your true identity.
Prerequisites Level 5
You can cast Self-Mirage as an ethereal innate spell with the focus trait. 
SHADOWY WHISPERS
KORNARGON
You can speak to those around you by throwing your voice across distance. 
You gain the Message cantrip which you may cast using your Spellcraft bonus. 
SHARE THOUGHTS
ASCENDAN 
You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other Ascendan without speaking. 
You can cast Telepathy as an innate spell at will, but you can only target other Ascendan.
SHROUDED DEMEANOUR
KORNARGON
Your experiences have honed your ability to navigate treacherous situations and contend with malevolent beings. You are well-acquainted with the perils that lie in wait and the ominous creatures that inhabit the plane of shadows. 
You gain a +2 racial bonus to Deception and Sense Motive checks. 
SMALL FOLK RIDER
HALFLING 
Raised amidst your village’s sturdy ponies and loyal riding dogs, you developed exceptional equestrian skills. 
As a result, you gain a +2 racial bonus to Handle Animal checks. Moreover, if you happen to be handling a traditional halfling mount like a pony or a riding dog, you gain an additional +` racial bonus to your Handle Animal checks. 
STONE WISE
DWARF 
Your keen eye for detail allows you to perceive even the slightest discrepancies and intricacies within the stonework that surrounds you.
You gain a +2 racial bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover traps of a mechanical nature if they are either hidden in or constructed of stone.
You also gain a +2 racial bonus to all Stone Lore (specialist skill) checks.
STONE-LIKE ENDURANCE
DWARF 
It is said that you have the spirit of the mountains running through your veins. 
Prerequisites Level 5
Gain a bonus to your HP equal to +1 per level. You also gain a +2 bonus to all dying checks and all exhaustion checks.
SUDDEN FORM

You can shift forms quickly.
Prerequisites Level 10, Hybrid Transformation 
Your Hybrid Transformation and Primal Shape abilities cost 1 less AP
SURE FOOTED
HALFLING 
Your feet, adorned with a layer of coarse hair and toughened skin, effortlessly find secure footholds, ensuring stability and grace in even the most precarious situations.
You gain Advantage on all Balance (Acrobatics) and Climb (Climbing) checks. 
SWIFT REFLEXES
ELF
Your heightened senses allow you to react with incredible speed and agility. 
You gain a +10 racial bonus to your initiative, ensuring that you are quick to act in any given situation. Furthermore, if your initiative roll happens to be tied with an opponent, your reflexes grant you the advantage of acting first.
SWIFT STRIDE 
ELF
Your stride is greater than others of your kind. 
You gain a +5 racial bonus to your Speed.
TEMPORAL GRASP

Prerequisites Level 5
You can cast Haste as an arcane innate spell with the focus trait, albeit limited to targeting only yourself.

Your base damage increases by +2 when you hit on an attack with a sling against a Large or larger creature.

Prerequisites Level 1 only
You gain tusks as an unarmed attack. Your tusks deal 1d6 piercing damage, are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

Your natural affinity for magic has taught you some unusual magic. 
You may add any one PP 2 ethereal spell to your spell repertoire. This is a bonus spell and does not need to be memorised and does not count towards your known spells.

You have learnt how to use a weapon which would normally be uncommon to you. 
You may select either an Exotic Weapon and treat it as a Martial Weapon or select a Martial Weapon and treat it as a Simple Weapon.
UNYIELDING TENACITY 
ORC
Your unwavering determination in battle fuels your resilience, allowing you to push through the brink of defeat. 
Action Reaction; Trigger You gain the Dying Condition but are not immediately killed; Frequency once per day
When faced with certain death, you refuse to succumb, keeping yourself on the edge of consciousness. As a result, you avoid the Dying Condition and maintain a single hit point. Additionally, any recurring damage or bleed effects caused by the attack is reduced by 2. However, the strain of the attack still takes its toll leaving you Injured 1.
VERDANT GNOME 
GNOME

Choose one cantrip from the verdant spell list. You can cast this spell using your Spellcraft bonus. 
VERDANT HEALING
GNOME 
Your connection to the natural world allows you to draw upon its natural healing reserves. 
If you rest for 10 minutes, you gain Hit Points equal to your level.

Prerequisites Level 5 
You can cast Speak with Animals as an innate spell once per day. This functions as the standard version of the spell, using your level as your caster level.
You gain one additional use of this ability per day at 9th level, and again every 4 levels thereafter (13th, 17th, etc.).

Prerequisites Level 10, Dracoris

WORLDLY
HUMAN 
You get along extremely well with members of other races and cultures, and thrive in diverse environments. 
You gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks made to interact with intelligent creatures without the human trait. You also gain a +2 racial bonus on all checks to recall knowledge about the customs of races and cultures other than your own.
ARCHETYPE FEATS
Archetype feats are a special type of feat which allow you to expand your characters class. Once you have selected an archetype feat, you must complete its progression requirements before you can select another. It is also important to be aware that some class feats might have an archetype as a trait, in which case you can select this feat if you already have the archetype feat. An archetype feat may only be selected using a class feat pick.
ADVENTURER
At a young age you developed the urge to travel and seek your fortune. It is often irrelevant what the mission is, but the quest itself and the loot and notoriety at its finale are what you thrive upon. 
You gain a +2-class bonus to all attempts to Recall Knowledge about ancient history, peoples, and cultures. Additionally, you may make any one skill a class skill. 
Progression Requirements Gained class skill +10 ranks
AEGIS
MARTIAL 
Some warriors may proclaim that an aggressive assault is the ultimate form of defence, you harbour reservations towards such brash claims, as they reek of excessive confidence; in your seasoned perspective, the true embodiment of a formidable defence lies in the presence of a sturdy shield, serving as an impenetrable barrier between you and your enemies. 
Prerequisites Shield Block, BAB +2
You are particularly skilled at using a shield in combat. You gain the Shield Focus feat. Additionally, when using the Fight Defensively or Full Defence actions whilst wielding a shield, you gain a +2 Dodge bonus to DB. 
Progression Requirements BAB +10

ASSASSIN
EXPERT

DEATH MARK 
CONCENTRATE 
Requirements You can see and hear the creature you intend to mark
Action 3 AP 
You designate a single creature as your mark. This lasts until the mark dies or you use Death Mark again. You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Attack, Perception and Feint actions against your mark. Your agile, finesse, unarmed and ranged (within first range increment) attacks made against your mark gain the deadly weapon trait against them. If the attack already has the deadly trait, increase the damage by 1.
Progression Requirements Perception and Stealth both +10 ranks 
Be aware that although assassins are primarily adept at terminating lives and often associated with malevolence, there exist a few who adhere to a strict moral code, targeting solely the wicked, the cruel, and those who embody unchecked aggression or wield excessive power.

ENIGMA
ADEPT HERITAGE
You have developed the ability to cast spells naturally and have never received any formal training. 
Prerequisites Pure Learned Caster.
You are an Instinctive caster (see Chapter 9) and do not have to memorise your spells during daily preparation. You replace your Class Magical Tradition rules with the following:
At 1st level you may select any two PP 2 spells from your magical casting tradition. You may cast these spells as long as you meet the casting requirements and do not need to memorise them. You do not need to spend 30 minutes each day as part of your daily preparation as your known spells are always available to you. 
Each time you gain a level you may select two new spells from your tradition spell list and add them to your repertoire. 
At 3rd level and then every two levels thereafter, you may swap any one spell from your repertoire for a new spell. 
You may also select any two cantrips from your magical tradition. These may also be swapped out as you progress levels as detailed above.
Furthermore, you may also gain additional spells by purchasing the Magical Discovery feat (see class feats later in this chapter). 
Finally, due to the raw nature of your power, you gain an additional 2 PP per level.

AGILE DISPLAY 
FLOURISH MOVEMENT 
Action 1 AP 
You Step 5 feet and may attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of one adjacent creature with the following results: 
Critical you may immediately Tumble through their space as part of this action. Furthermore, the creature is Flat-Footed against your next melee Strike which must be made before the end of your turn.
Success the creature is Flat-Footed against your next melee Strike which must be made before the end of your turn.
Failure no further effect.
Blunder you fall prone and your turn ends.

MASTERMIND
BARD RANGER ROGUE

Prerequisites Either Arcana, Crafting, Culture, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion 2 ranks
You gain the Sense Weakness ability and also gain a +1-class bonus when using Recall Knowledge to identify creatures.
SENSE WEAKNESS 
CONCENTRATE 
After observing any one target that you can see, you can make a Recall Knowledge check. The amount of time you spend observing the target applies the following modifiers to the check: 2 AP (+2), 1 AP (+0). 
If you get a minimum of a success result, that creature is flat-footed against your attacks until the start of your next turn; if you get a critical result, it's flat-footed against your attacks for 1 minute.
Be aware that once you have used this ability on a target, they become immune for 1 minute.
Progression Requirements Arcana, Crafting, Culture, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion +10 ranks

RUNEMAGE

You have learnt the magic of the ancient magical runes and use them to enhance your power. 
Prerequisites Linguistics 2 ranks
The way that you cast your spells is different to other casters and you replace all non-somatic components with a new component called Symbol. When using the Symbol component your spells are changed in the following ways:
• All casting DCs are reduced by 1
• All Save DCs are increased by 1
• You must have room to draw the rune for a spell (in the air or otherwise)
• All Defensive Casting DCs are increased by 2
You also gain a +2-class bonus on all checks made to identify runic symbols.

CLASS FEATS
Class feats are specialist feats which are only available to certain character classes or class types (Adept, Expert or Warrior). If a feat in this section has a class trait or class type trait, then you must have at least one of those traits to qualify for the feat. Some class feats may have an archetype trait, in which case this is treated as a class feat for the purpose of qualification. Some of the feats in this section do not have a class feat and are therefore available to any character class for selection. 
If you meet the prerequisites, you may select any class feat.
ACCURATE SPELL
ADEPT
You are very precise when it comes to unleashing targeted spell attacks. 
When attacking a target in melee with a spell, you ignore the +4 standard cover bonus that each target gains.
Be aware that this feat only ignores the static penalty for firing into melee, it does not ignore any additional bonuses that the target creature may gain from cover and concealment.
ACROBATIC BLUFF
EXPERT
You have learnt to feint using sudden movement.
You can use your Acrobatics skill in place of your Deception skill to feint in combat. Your opponent opposes the attempt with Sense Motive or Acrobatics (whichever is better).
AGGRESSIVE MAGIC
ADEPT
You know how to get the most out of the destructive side of magic. 
All elemental spell attacks gain a +2-class bonus to the attack roll. Unfortunately, the things that live in dark places have taken note of your power and all Fumble checks and Resonance Events are made at +10. Furthermore, you provoke Resonance Events on a 33 rolled on any Spell Fumble or Spell Critical Injury rolls.
AGILE STRIKES 
Your unparalleled finesse with nimble weapons exceeds expectation, showcasing a mesmerizing display of grace and skill. 
Your multiple attack penalty becomes –3 for your second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8) for attacks that have the agile trait.
AIDING ARCHERY
ARCHER ATTACK MARTIAL PRESS
With a swift and precise shot, you disrupt an opponent's focus in combat. 
You may use both the Aid Defensive and Aid Offensive actions with a missile weapon. Furthermore, these actions gain a +1-circumstance bonus. 
ALIGNED SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC SAVE
Your spells creatures of a certain faith or demeanour. 
Requirement Divine Caster only
PP Cost +1 or +2
You can cause your spell to only affect targets with either the chaos, evil, good, or order alignment traits chosen at the time of casting. 
You can warp the spell by a further PP to affect a second trait.
ALIGNMENT CHANNEL
CLERIC
You have developed techniques to cause your positive energy to harm eternals. 
Any spell or ability that you have which affects creatures of the undead type in a harmful way, may also be applied to affect eternals with the evil trait.

Action Reaction; Trigger You take an action with the attack trait 
After making an attack action, you may choose a friendly creature within 30’ who can see and hear you. The chosen creature can immediately make a bonus free attack against one target that is within range. This is attack ignores multiple attack penalties.

ARCANE KNIGHT
ARCANIST
You have a little skill with arcane magic but are far from being an expert in such matters. Although your expertise lies in different fields, you do have access to some arcane tricks.
Prerequisites Arcana 4 ranks, Int +3
Your arcane prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 arcane spell. 
ARMOURED COUNTER 
CRUSADER FIGHTER
You lock an opponent’s weapon in your steely grasp, pulling the foe off balance. 
Prerequisites Survival 8 ranks, you are wearing medium or heavy armour.
Action Reaction; Trigger An opponent strikes you and inflicts HP damage with no critical. 
You may use any 1 AP attack action against your target ignoring multiple attack penalty.
ASSESS TARGET
ATTACK FIGHTER 
Prerequisites BAB +2, Warfare
Action 2 AP 
You make a carefully considered attack against your foe in an attempt to learn their strengths and weaknesses. 
You make a melee Strike against your target (which is resolved normally). If you hit, you can attempt a Recall Knowledge check as a Free Action using your Warfare bonus to learn about the target. This check is made with a -2-circumstance penalty but if you inflict a critical there is no penalty. 
Once you have used this feat against a target, they become immune to it until after your next daily preparations.
ASSESS TRACKS
DRUID RANGER
You can discern certain details about creatures through their tracks. 
Prerequisites Survival 10 ranks 
Make a Level based Survival check against the creature you are tracking or against their Survival DC, if they are actively covering their tracks. If successful, you learn the creature’s base speed plus one additional detail for every point by which your check exceeds the Difficulty. The information you gain includes whether a creature has a climb or swim speed, its movement-based feats or traits, and possibly other information such as the creature’s diet, size, and obvious supernatural traits (a fire creature, for instance, may scorch the ground when it walks), at the GM’s discretion.
If you fail the track check, you may retry after an hour of further observation. 
BARDIC LORE
BARD
You know a little about a great many things. 
Your ability to pick up obscure knowledge and gossip grants you your class bonus to all Recall Knowledge checks. Furthermore, you may attempt to make Arcana, Occultism, Nature and Religion checks untrained, even they would normally require you to be trained in the skill.
BEYOND REACH 
EXPERT MARTIAL
You have mastered the art of moving to avoid melee attacks. 
Prerequisites Acrobatics10 ranks
Action Reaction; Trigger An opponent moves into a range where they can hit you with their melee attacks. 
Whenever an opponent moves into a range where they can hit you with their melee attacks, you may make an Acrobatics check against the opponents Attack DC. If you succeed, you may as a reaction, move back five feet, keeping your opponent at bay by leaving the range of their melee attack. The opponent may then continue their turn and may choose to advance on you again, so long as they have movement left.
You cannot take the 5 ft step away if it would carry you into the range of a different foe’s melee attacks or if you are cornered and have no place to go.
BLIND FIGHT
EXPERT MARTIAL 
You have learnt to fight using senses other than sight. 
Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks 
You ignore the concealed condition when attacking creatures that are within the range of a non-visual sense. You’re not flat-footed to creatures that are hidden from you (unless you’re flat-footed to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and the flat check for a creature to avoid your attack when hidden is 15 rather than 10.
While you’re adjacent to an undetected creature, it is instead only hidden from you.
BRAVERY
MARTIAL
You have developed a will of iron when in the face of adversity. 
You gain +2 circumstance bonus against all emotion and fear-based saving throws. Furthermore, you reduce the severity of the frightened condition by 1 each time you succumb to it. 
CHANCE OF REDEMPTION
CLERIC CRUSADER 
Your foe hesitates under the weight of their sins. 
Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks
Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 10 feet of you. 
The foe must make a Level based (opposed) Will Saving throw. 
Critical The target is unaffected
Success The attack result is reduced by 2.
Failure The attack result is reduced by 4.
Fumble As failure and the enemy is also Stunned 2.

HEIGHTEN SPELL

When you heighten a spell, you are increasing its raw power level which makes it more difficult to dispel (and potentially resist). Heightening a spell treats the PP of the spell for Saving Throw DC purposes as the maximum PP that you can cast. 
Salios is Wizard with a caster level of 13. The maximum PP spell that he can cast is 14. He casts a Blindness spell and uses the Heighten Feat which increase the PP cost of the spell by 2 (from 6 to 8) but the spell is treated as PP 14 for the purposes of the Saving Throw DC.

Your Ambush or Sniping (Stealth) check is made as a Free Action (0 AP) instead of a Reaction.
PRECISE SHOT
ARCHER FIGHTER RANGER
You are not easily distracted when target enemies in melee. 
Prerequisites Point Blank Shot
When firing a missile weapon into melee, you ignore the +4 standard cover bonus that each target gains.
Be aware that this feat only ignores the static penalty for firing into melee, it does not ignore any additional bonuses that the target creature may gain from cover and concealment.
PRIMAL DEFENDER
ANIMIST
You have fought alongside rangers and druids picking up some of their magical knowledge. 
Prerequisites Nature 4 ranks, Con +3
Your verdant prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 verdant spell. 
PROPER HARDMAN
MARTIAL
You have trained to use your strength to its fullest when making attacks with melee weapons. 
Prerequisites BAB +10 
Your strength is multiplied by 1.5 when determining your melee damage bonus.
QUICK DRAW
EXPERT MARTIAL 
You draw your melee or thrown weapon and attack with the same motion. 
Prerequisites BAB +2
You use a 1 AP to Interact and Strike with your weapon.
QUICK RELOAD
ARCHER FLOURISH
You can notch an arrow with lightning like precision. 
Prerequisites BAB +4
You reduce the AP cost to reload your missile by one AP (min 0).
QUICKEN SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC FLOURISH 
You can cast spells with amazing speed. 
PP Cost +8 
You reduce the AP cost required to cast the spell by 1 (minimum 1).
RADIANT BLADE
CRUSADER 
Your blade ally is imbued with even more power. 
Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally), BAB +10
You may add the aligned and flaming weapon property runes to the list that you may select during daily preparation. Any aligned trait that you select must match that of your deific aspect or deity.
REACH SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You can increase the range of your spells. 
PP Cost +2 
Double the range of an existing spell. If the spell has no range or a range of touch, this warping option has no effect.
REACTIVE STANCE
FIGHTER ROGUE
When there’s imminent danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought. 
Prerequisites BAB +10
Action Free; Trigger You roll initiative.
Enter any one known Stance that you know.
RESOLVE
ADEPT ADVANTAGE
You have a mind of iron when resisting mental effects. 
Prerequisites Mental Focus 6 ranks
Action Reaction; Trigger You attempt a will save, before you roll.
You gain advantage on the resulting saving throw.
REVERSE STRIKE
FLOURISH MARTIAL PRESS 
You turn your foes’ flanking against them with a quick reverse. 
Prerequisites BAB +4 
Requirements You are flanked by at least two enemies.
Action 1 AP
Make two Strike actions, one each against two separate targets that are currently flanking you. Both attacks use the same multiple attack penalty and only count as one attack for increasing the penalty further. 
SACRED WEAPON
CLERIC CRUSADER
You inscribe the symbol of your deity or deific aspect onto a favoured weapon. 
You etch a sacred symbol onto a favoured weapon which takes 10 minutes. This symbol remains for a full year, however if you etch a symbol onto a different weapon, the original one instantly vanishes. Once the symbol has been inscribed, the item transforms into a religious symbol of the gods, serving as a divine focus for members of your faith.
Additionally, the item also becomes a +1 Divine Spell Adder.
SECOND ALLY
CRUSADER 
The power of your devotion draws additional boons from your deity.
Prerequisites Divine Ally, BAB +8
You may select an additional Divine Ally from those available to you.
SELECTIVE SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
Select targets to avoid the wrath of your spells.
PP Cost +1 per target 
When casting a spell with an area of effect you can choose several targets in the area equal to the additional PP expended. These targets are excluded from the effects of your spell.
Be aware that you must be aware of your allies to exclude them from the spell.
SELF PRESERVATION
CLERIC CRUSADER EVIL 
Your focus lies in self-preservation and survivability. 
Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks
Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy that you are aware of damages you with a targeted attack.
Your DR increases by 2 + half your level against the triggering attack.
Furthermore, your Strikes against the triggering creature deal +1 aligned (evil) or essence base damage until the end of your next turn. The damage type may be different each time you use this ability. 
SHADOWING
MARTIAL
You instantly pursue a retreating foe. 
Prerequisites BAB +4
Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within reach attempts to move away from you.
You follow a retreating creature by taking a 1 AP Stride action as a Reaction. You remain within reach of the creature until it either stops moving, or you have moved your full Speed
You can use Shadowing with any movement type that you have available.
SHIELD BLOCK
MARTIAL 
You quickly block an incoming attack with your shield. 
Action Reaction; Trigger You take damage from an attack.
Your shield grants you DR against the incoming attack equal to its DR bonus (if it has one). You and your shield take any further damage.
Furthermore, after using Shield Block, you lose your shield bonus to DB until the beginning of your next turn.
Be aware that if your shield does not have a DR bonus, it cannot be used to Shield Block.
SHIELD FOCUS
MARTIAL
You possess exceptional skill in using your shield to deflect incoming attacks. 
You increase the DB bonus granted by any shield by +1.
SHIELDED STRIDE
AEGIS MARTAL 
You deflect your enemies blows whilst moving. 
Prerequisites Shield Block, BAB +4
Your shield bonus to DB is increased by +4 against actions which are provoked via movement. You cannot use Shielded Stride with a buckler.
SIGNATURE SPELL
ADEPT 
Experience allows you to cast a spell with more flexibility. 
Select any one of your spells, when you Warp this spell, the total PP cost of the spell is reduced by 1 PP.
SILENT SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You can cast without the use of your voice. 
PP Cost +2 
You remove the verbal component from a spell. This does not alter the amount of AP required to cast the spell, just prevents you from having to speak aloud when casting the spell.
SKIRMISH
FLOURISH RANGER ROGUE
Your footwork is perfection personified whilst attacking. 
Prerequisites BAB +4
Action 1 AP
You may take a Strike action and Step action together for 1 AP. It matters not, which order you carry the actions out in.
SMITE EVIL
CRUSADER GOOD
You enhance your Blade Ally with a small aspect of your deity. 
Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally)
Action 1 AP 
Until the beginning of your next turn your Strikes made with your Blade Ally weapon inflict an additional 1d6 base good damage.
SMITE GOOD
CRUSADER EVIL
You enhance your Blade Ally with a small aspect of your deity. 
Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally)
Action 1 AP 
Until the beginning of your next turn your Strikes made with your Blade Ally weapon inflict an additional 1d6 base evil damage. 
SPECIALIST SPELL
When you select this feat you gain a new specialist spell for which you meet the prerequisites. If a specialist spell requires a unique feat to purchase it, you may not select it with this feat.
You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a different specialist spell.
SPELL SUBSTITUTION
ADEPT
You can switch out a prepared spell for another one from your repertoire.
Prerequisites Meditation 5 ranks, Learned Caster, BSB +5
You spend 10 minutes in quiet contemplation and then make a Meditation check with a DC equal to the casting DC of the spell. 
Critical You swap the spell successfully.
Success You swap the spell successfully and may not use this ability again for another hour.
Partial As success, but you may not use this feat again until after your next daily preparation. 
Failure You fail to swap the spell and may not use this feat again until after your next daily preparation. 
If you are interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.
SPLIT SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You reduce the power of your attack spell by splitting it into multiple shots.
PP Cost +4 per additional target 
Your Spell Attack check is compared to the DB of multiple targets within the spell's range. The damage die of the spell attack is reduced by one step per additional target (d8 becomes d6 for one additional target or d4 two additional targets etc). This counts as one attack for your multiple attack penalty.
SPONTANEOUS SCHOLAR
ADEPT
Your extensive knowledge of magic and its intricacies enables you to cast certain spells even when you have not studied your spell library for the day. By relying on rote memory and natural talent, you can call upon a limited number of spells in moments of need.
Prerequisites Learned Caster, BSB +2, Int +2
You gain the ability to cast a number of spells without studying your spell library. The number of spells you can cast in this way equals your Intelligence ability score per day. These spells must come from your known repertoire (spells already in your spell library) and must be of a PP cost no higher than half your caster level (rounded up).
STANCE MASTERY
CONCENTRATE FIGHTER ROGUE
Your study of combat techniques is beyond compare. 
Prerequisites BAB +12, Reactive Stance
Action 1 AP; Trigger You are already in a stance.
When you are in a Stance, you may activate a second stance and have both running alongside each other. Such advanced techniques are taxing however and for each round beyond the 1st that you maintain both stances you must make an Exhaustion check with a failure also resulting in both stances dropping.
STEALTHY STRIKE
EXPERT THIEF
You can catch a target off guard, to inflict serious wounds to them.
Prerequisites Non-Rogue, Stealth 2 ranks
If you Strike a creature that is flanked or that has the flat-footed condition with an agile or finesse melee attack, or a ranged weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 precision damage. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee weapon, that weapon must also be agile or finesse.
As your stealth skill increases, so does the amount of additional damage you inflict. Increase the amount by 1d6 for every 6 ranks you have in the skill.
STILL SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You can cast your spells without the need for hand gestures.
PP Cost +2 
You remove the somatic component from a spell. This does not alter the amount of AP required to cast the spell, just prevents you from having to use somatic components.
STORMBORN
DRUID
You are at home out in the elements, revelling in the power of nature unleashed. 
You take no circumstance penalties for ranged spell attacks or Perception checks caused by weather, and your targeted spells ignore the concealed condition if it is caused by weather (such as fog).
STRIDING CHARGE 
FLOURISH MARTIAL
You surge forward with relentless determination, forcefully clearing a path through adversaries to swiftly close in on your intended target. 
Prerequisites Athletics 5 ranks
Action 2 AP
You make one Stride action and attempt to move straight through your enemies', finishing with a melee attack. Make an Athletics check comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature you attempt to pass through during your Stride action, continuing to move on a success but ending your movement before entering its space on a failure. If you reach your intended target, you may make a 1 AP Attack action. 
Be aware that this action does not provoke reactions.
STRIKE OF RETRIBUTION
CLERIC CRUSADER GOOD 
You place yourself in harm’s way and lash out at your enemy.
Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks
Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy damages your ally within 10 feet of you.
You move without provoking, as part of the reaction adjacent to the attacker. You then intercept the attack which targeted your ally. The attack is worked out against your Defensive Bonus and if it hits, you may immediately make a melee strike against the foe. This attack is not subject to your multiple attack bonus.
SUDDEN CHARGE
FLOURISH MARTIAL OPEN 
Your ability to close the distance between you and your foes is legendary.
Prerequisites Athletics 1 rank
It only costs you 2 Action Points to Charge instead of 3.
SUPERIOR EVASION
RANGER ROGUE
Your ability to avoid damage is surpassed by very few. 
Prerequisites Evasion, Acrobatics 12 ranks 
When using your evasion ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.
SUPERIOR JUGGERNAUT
MARTIAL
Your ability to withstand physical trauma is legendary. 
Prerequisites Juggernaut, Athletics 12 ranks 
When using your juggernaut ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.
SUPERIOR RESOLVE
ADEPT
Your ability to resist mental effects is second to none. 
Prerequisites Resolve, Mental Focus 12 ranks 
When using your resolve ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.
SURPRISE ATTACK
EXPERT
You can react at the beginning of a combat just a little quicker than others.
Prerequisites Perception 6 ranks
All opponents are flat-footed to you in the surprise round regardless of whether they have acted or not.
SWIPE
FLOURISH MARTIAL
You swing your weapon in a wide arc.
Prerequisites BAB +4
Spend 2 AP to perform a single melee Strike, then compare the attack result to the DB of up to two adjacent foes within your melee reach. The Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. If your weapon has the sweep trait, its modifier applies to all Swipe attacks.
TEMPORAL EXTENSION
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You manipulate the flow of time to extend your spells beyond their natural limits.
PP Cost varies 
With careful energy management, you push your magical boundaries, ensuring your power lasts when it matters most.
You can extend the duration of a spell by stepping it up to the next duration category:
• Rounds - Minutes
• Minutes - 10-Minute Intervals
• 10-Minute Intervals - Hours
• Hours - Half-Day Intervals
Each step requires a PP expenditure equal to half the spell's base PP cost, rounded up. The extension must be decided at the time of casting and does not stack with other duration modifiers.
TRACKLESS STEP
ADVANTAGE DRUID RANGER
You are very difficult to track whilst moving through areas of natural terrain.
Prerequisites Survival 5 ranks
Attempts to track you are made at disadvantage.
TURN UNDEAD
CLERIC
Calling upon the power of your god(s), you cause undead to flee from the might of your divinity. 
When using your Channels ability, you may instead use the Turn Undead spell. 
TWIN PARRY
FIGHTER RANGER 
You use your offhand weapon to parry with great skill. 
Prerequisites BAB +4
Any weapon in your offhand is considered to have the Parry trait. If your off-hand weapon already has the parry trait its bonus is increased by +1. You must have a weapon in your offhand to gain this bonus.
TWIN RIPOSTE
FIGHTER RANGER 
As your target makes a mistake, you use your offhand weapon to take advantage. 
Prerequisites Double Stance, BAB +8
Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within your reach fumbles a Strike against and you are in Double Stance.
You may take either an Attack or Disarm action against the target. Your multiple attack penalty does not apply to this action.
VARIABLE SUCCESS
ADEPT METAMAGIC
Your casting skills are not as delicate as your contemporaries, but usually work nonetheless. 
Prerequisites BSB +8
When you get a partial result whilst casting a spell, you may expend an amount of PP equal to the base cost of the spell to change the result to a success.
VERSATILE CHANNELS
CLERIC 
You can use your channels to heal more than just hit point damage. 
Prerequisites BSB +8
You can expend one of your uses of channels to cast either a remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis or restore senses spell. The spell is warped to your maximum PP.
VERSATILE FAMILIAR
WIZARD
You familiar is mutable, able to shift its focus and abilities. 
Prerequisites Empower Familiar, Familiar, BSB +8
During your daily preparation, your familiar may switch out any one of its familiar abilities for another. It must meet any prerequisites for the new ability. More information on Familiars can be found at the end of this chapter.
VITAL STRIKE
ATTACK MARTIAL 
You aim to strike at your targets vital points by sacrificing the amount of attacks you can make each round for more precision. 
Prerequisites BAB +6
Action 2 AP 
You make a single attack against your target and may specify a hit location from the following:
Arms, Legs, Torso, Abdomen or Head
If the attack is a critical hit, when you roll the critical, you may increase your critical result to the next one that affects this location.
VOID STEP
EXPERT FOCUS
You move with speed and precision, attempting to elude your target's gaze. 
Prerequisites Stealth 12 ranks, Mobility
When you use a Stride action, you may choose to avoid provoking reactions during this movement. At the end of your movement, you can attempt a Stealth check against a single target's Perception DC. If successful, you are hidden from that target until the start of your next turn, unless you attack or take another noticeable action. 
WARP MANIPULATION
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You have the ability to alter your spells as you have cast them.
Prerequisites BSB +10
Requirements You have successfully cast a spell and exceeded the casting DC by a minimum of 2.
Action Free
After successfully casting a spell, you may add a warping option of up to 2 PP. You must still expend the additional PP for this option.
If the result of the spell is a Critical, you may add a warping option of up to 4. This replaces the usual benefit of achieving a Critical on your spell check.
WEAPON MASTERY
MARTIAL
You rarely make mistakes when fighting with your preferred weapons.
Prerequisites Weapon Focus, BAB +6
You attack with grace and finesse when using the weapons selected from your Weapon Focus feat. You reduce the Fumble DC for all weapons covered by Weapon Focus by 1 for every 6 BAB. (to a minimum of 4).
WEAPON SPECIALISATION
FIGHTER
You are skilled at dealing damage with one weapon group. 
Prerequisites Weapon Mastery, BAB +8
Choose one weapon group for which you have already selected the Weapon Focus feat. You deal +2 extra base damage when using weapons from this group.
WIDEN SPELL
ADEPT METAMAGIC 
You are capable of affecting a wider area with your spells.
PP Cost +4 
You can alter a burst, emanation, or spread-shaped spell to increase its area. Any numeric measurements of the spell's area increase by 100%.
WILD STRIDE
DRUID RANGER
You move quickly through natural obstacles, whether they’re tumbled stone, tangled undergrowth, or sucking mud. 
You can ignore the effects of non-magical difficult terrain. As normal for ignoring difficult terrain, this also lets you treat the hindrances of formidable terrain as those of difficult terrain.
WYRM SHAPE
DRUID
You can assume the forms of the great wyrms. 
Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +12
You may use your Wild Shape ability to take the form of a Wyrm as if using the Shape of the Wyrm spell. 
Furthermore, whenever you use Wildshape to change into a different form, you gain resistance to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison. 
GENERAL FEATS
This section deals with any feats which are associated with skills, actions or any feat that does not fall into any one of the other categories. The majority of these feats will directly interact with a skill, or an action adding bonuses or amending the way it works in some way. 
ACCOMPLISHED ARTISAN
Your training focused upon the creation of one particular kind of item.
Prerequisites Any one crafting specialist skill.
When creating items using your crafting specialty, you are considered to be 2 levels higher for the purpose of determining your crafting times.
ADOPTIVE RACE
HERITAGE
You were raised by a race of humanoids other than your own, you’ve always considered yourself one of them. 
Select one playable PC race (GM approval). You select your racial heritage and racial feats from the adopted race instead of your own. You cannot select any feats that require a physiological feature (such as Orc Tusks) but may be able to select such feats from your original race (GM discretion).
Garrok Bloodfang is an Orc whose tribe were destroyed by giants when he was an infant. He was adopted by an elven ranger and raised in their small village. Garrok has the Silvarni heritage and may select elven feats with no physical traits. He selects the Tusks feat at 1st level as this is a Feat that his GM deems physical. 
AFFABLE
ADVANTAGE 
You have the ability to create fast friends, even among those whom you have just met. 
Prerequisites Diplomacy 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Make an Impression (Diplomacy) checks. Furthermore, you may affect multiple targets with this check by taking a -1-circumstance penalty for each target beyond the first.
AGILE TUMBLER
ADVANTAGE
Your swift and nimble movements allow you to weave through your opponents with unparalleled agility. 
Prerequisites Acrobatics 8 ranks
You gain advantage on all Tumble (Acrobatics) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus on the next physical attack or skill check that you make, which must be made before the end of your turn.
ALCHEMICAL CRAFTING
You can create alchemical items.
Prerequisites Crafting or Nature 1 rank
You may use the Create (Crafting or Nature) action to make Alchemical items. Each item requires a formula for you to be able to make it. You may add the formula for any one level 1 Alchemical item when you select this feat.
ALERTNESS
ADVANTAGE 
Your keen observational skills allow you to perceive details that often elude others.
Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks
You gain advantage on all Search (Perception) checks.
AMBUSH AWARENESS
You have a knack for avoiding blows when surprised. 
Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks
If you are unable to act in the surprise round because you failed a Perception check, you can still act on your initiative count in the surprise round, but only to take the Full Defence action.
ANIMAL AFFINITY
ADVANTAGE 
You have a natural empathy when dealing with creatures with the animal trait. 
Prerequisites Handle Animal & Nature 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Command an Animal (Handle Animal) checks that you make.
ANIMAL INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE 
You have knack for getting animals to do what you want them to do.
Prerequisites Handle Animal 4 ranks, Animal Affinity
You gain a +2-class bonus on all Command an Animal (Handle Animal) checks. Furthermore, you gain a +1-class bonus to all Spellcraft checks made when casting spells which directly affect animals.
ARCANE INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE 
All things arcane come naturally to you.
Prerequisites Arcana & Power Manipulation 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Recall Knowledge (Arcana) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain an additional piece of information relating to the subject (GM discretion).
ARMOUR FOCUS
Your familiarity with a specific type of armour enhances its protective capabilities for you. 
Prerequisites BAB +1, Armour Proficiency 
Select one type of armour (leather, chainmail, scalemail etc). The DR of the selected armour increases by 1.
You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a different armour.
ARMOUR PROFICIENCY, HEAVY
You are proficient in the use of heavy armour. 
Prerequisites Armour Proficiency, Medium 
You take the listed ACP to Dexterity and Strength based checks whilst wearing heavy armour.
Be aware that if you wear armour that you are not proficient in, all penalties are doubled.
ARMOUR PROFICIENCY, LIGHT
You are proficient in the use of light armour. 
You take the listed ACP to Dexterity and Strength based checks whilst wearing light armour.
Be aware that if you wear armour that you are not proficient in, all penalties are doubled.
ARMOUR PROFICIENCY, MEDIUM
You are proficient in the use of medium armour. 
Prerequisites Armour Proficiency, Light 
You take the listed ACP to Dexterity and Strength based checks whilst wearing medium armour.
Be aware that if you wear armour that you are not proficient in, all penalties are doubled.
ARTISTIC EXPERTISE
ADVANTAGE 
Your performance skills surpass many others. 
Prerequisites Artistry & Perform 1 rank
You may select any one Artistic Skill Specialty. You gain advantage when making skill checks for this specialty.
You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a different specialty.
ARTISTIC SPECIALIST
You have expanded your artistic repertoire. 
Prerequisites Artistry 5 ranks
You may select an additional Artistry Skill Specialty. 
You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a new specialty.
BATTLE CRY
You can demoralise your foes with a quick shout. 
Prerequisites Intimidate 5 ranks 
As you roll for initiative, you may unleash a powerful battle cry, which serves to demoralize an observed creature as a free action. Furthermore, if you possess at least 10 ranks in Intimidate, when you land a critical hit upon a target, you may use a reaction to Demoralize your foe.
BATTLE HARDENED
You can ignore a certain amount of pain.
Prerequisites Toughness I, BAB +10 
You are immune to the first 2 points of either the Weakened or Injured condition that you receive each day and reduce all bleed condition values by 1.
BATTLE MEDIC
You can keep your cool in combat applying emergency treatment to your allies.
Prerequisites Medicine 2 ranks 
Action 3 AP; Requirements You are holding healer's tools, or you are wearing them and have a hand free 
You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for Treat Wounds and restore the corresponding amount of HP. 
BORN TO RIDE
You have exceptional skill in the saddle. 
Prerequisites Handle Animal 5 ranks 
Once per round you may use an action to command your steed, guide with knees or stay in saddle (using Handle Animal) as a Free Action.
BOUNDLESS LEAPER
ADVANTAGE
Your powerful legs propel you through the air with ease, allowing you to clear great distances and heights. 
Prerequisites Athletics 5 ranks 
You gain advantage on all High Jump and Long Jump (Athletics) checks. 
BREATH CONTROL
Your exceptional breath control bestows upon you significant advantages when faced with hazardous or sparse air conditions.
You can hold your breath for 10 times as long as usual before suffocating. You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons.
BREW POTION
You can create magical potions.
Prerequisites Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion 1 rank
You may use the Create (Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion) action to make Potions. Each item requires a formula for you to be able to make it. You may add the formula for any one level 1 Potion when you select this feat.
CANNY CUTPURSE 
ADVANTAGE 
You have are adept at filching purses and other valuables from unwitting marks. 
Prerequisites Thievery 5 ranks
You gain advantage on all Pickpocket (Thievery) checks.
CANNY SMUGGLER
ADVANTAGE 
Smuggling things past the authorities has become almost a challenge for you.
Prerequisites Stealth 5 ranks, Underworld
Any attempts to locate items which you are smuggling are made at disadvantage. Furthermore, when using Underworld to make Earn Income checks, the level of the work is always treated as 1 higher without affecting the DC. 
CLASS TRAINING
You have developed an additional ability which is only available to your class. 
You can select any one Class Feat for which you meet the pre-requisites.
COMBAT CASTING
You are adept at spellcasting when threatened or distracted. 
Prerequisites BSB +2
You gain a +2-class bonus to all attempts to defensive cast. Furthermore, you half the recurring and bleed damage penalties to spell casting (round down).
COUNTER SPELL
You can attempt to counter a spell as you identify it.
Prerequisites Spell Recognition, BSB +4
Action Free
If you successfully identify a spell using Spell Recognition, you may attempt to counter it using the Dispel (Power Manipulation) action as a Free action.
CULTURAL UNDERSTANDING
You understand people and their languages. 
Prerequisites Culture & Linguistics 1 rank
You gain a +1-class bonus to your Culture and Linguistic skills.
DEADLY TRAINING
Prerequisites Stealth 8 ranks
You have been trained in the skills of efficiently killing opponents. 
You gain a +2-class bonus when using the Ambush (Stealth) and Sniping actions
DEFT HANDS
ADVANTAGE
Prerequisites Thievery 5 ranks
You can palm small objects with ease. 
You gain Advantage on all Trickery (Thievery) checks.
DIEHARD
Prerequisites Con +2
Simply put, you are just too stubborn to die. 
You gain a +1-class bonus to your Death State and also gain a +2-circumstance bonus to all Dying Checks.
ESCAPOLOGIST
Your ability to slip your bonds quickly is almost superhuman. 
Prerequisites Acrobatics 8 ranks 
When making Escape (Acrobatics) checks, the action loses the Attack trait.
EXPERIENCED TRACKER
Following tracks is in your blood and it comes as almost second nature to you.
Prerequisites Survival 1 rank
You no longer take the penalty for tracking at full speed. 
FAITHFUL INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE 
The calmness that you find is divine inspired. 
Prerequisites Meditation & Religion 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Recall Knowledge (Religion) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain an additional piece of information relating to the subject (GM discretion).
FEARSOME GLARE
A mere glance of the eye is all it takes for you to strike fear into your enemies. 
Prerequisites Intimidate 2 ranks 
When you use the Demoralise (Intimidate) action, it loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait. Furthermore, the difficulty does not increase if the creature doesn’t understand your language.
FEATHER STEP
You glide across difficult terrain in short steps. 
Prerequisites Dex +3
You can Step into difficult terrain as if it was normal terrain.
FLAWLESS PERFORMANCE
ADVANTAGE
You are a perfectionist when performing your practised songs or dances.
Prerequisites Perform 1 rank
You gain advantage when using Performance or Earn Income (Perform) checks with one perform specialty. 
Be aware that you cannot use this feat to gain advantage if the Perform skill is being used to do something else (such as cast a bard spell).
FLEET FOOTED
You can move more quickly. 
Prerequisites Dex +2
You increase your Speed by 5 feet.
GOOD HEALER
Your expertise lies in swiftly tending to short-term injuries, allowing you to efficiently restore your allies and return them to the fray. 
Prerequisites Medicine 5 ranks
Whenever you Treat Wounds, you heal an additional amount of hit points equal to your ranks in Medicine.
GREAT FORTITUDE
Hours of physical training has paid off. 
You gain a +2-class bonus to your Fortitude saving throw.
GROUP COERCION
You are adept at influencing multiple targets with threats.
Prerequisites Intimidate 1 rank
When you Coerce, you ignore the first -4 penalty received for coercing multiple targets. For every 5 ranks that you have in the Intimidate skill, you may ignore a further -2 penalty.
GYMNASTIC TRAINING
You are skilled at dextrous manoeuvring. 
Prerequisites Acrobatics 1 rank
You gain a +1-class bonus to the Acrobatics skill and Reflex saving throws.
HAULER
You are stronger than you look. 
Prerequisites Athletics 1 rank
Your strength is considered to be 2 higher when determining encumbrance limits and tests of pure strength.
IMPRESSIVE PERFORMANCE
Prerequisites Perform 1 rank
Your captivating performances elicit admiration and cultivate a devoted fanbase. 
You can Make an Impression using Performance instead of Diplomacy.
IMPROVED INITIATIVE
You have superior reactions. 
You gain a +20-circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
IMPROVED REPOSITION 
You are very adept at protecting weaker allies. 
You no longer need a free hand to use the Reposition action. In addition, you make a Reflex DC (against your targets level DC) to avoid reactions when using this action.
INCREDIBLY INVESTED
You have the ability to bond with more magic items. 
Prerequisites Cha +2
Increase your limit on invested items by 2.
INNER RESERVE
Fatigue is for fools and wizards (maybe they are one and the same). 
Prerequisites Str +2, Con +2, Mettle, Level 10
You have an innate ability to take more physical punishment than others. You gain a +1 per level bonus to your HP and a +2-class bonus to all exhaustion checks and saving throws to resist fatigue.
INSTINCTIVE DEFENCE
Your training and reflexes allow you to react swiftly to avoid an opponents' attacks.
Prerequisites Dex +2, Acrobatics 5 ranks
Requirements You are not suffering from an ACP or encumbrance penalty.
You gain a +1-dodge bonus to DB.
INTUITIVE HEALER
You just know when things are wrong. 
Prerequisites Medicine & Sense Motive 1 rank
You gain a +1-class bonus to your Medicine skill.
INVENTIVE CRAFTER
You possess a keen mind for design and innovation, able to reverse-engineer creations and develop entirely new ones from scratch. 
Prerequisite 5 or more ranks in any skill that has both the create and research actions.
You may attempt to invent a formula for an item you do not yet know. This process uses the Research action, but instead of constructing the item, you are developing the formula through research and experimentation.
This process is the same as that to create an item but with the following differences:
• You don’t need the formula for the item.
• You must supply raw materials equal to half the cost of the item you are creating, not the cost of the formula.
Be aware that you must still have the required feat for specialist items such as alchemical and magical items.
IRON WILL
Hours of focusing your weave has granted fruition. 
You gain a +2-class bonus to your Will saving throw.
KEEN INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE
You have a knack for listening in to conversations and gaining valuable insight from them.
Prerequisites Diplomacy 1 rank
You gain Advantage to all Gather Information (Diplomacy) checks. 
LIGHTNING REFLEXES
Your ability to notice incoming danger has always given you an edge.
You gain a +2-class bonus to your Reflex saving throw.
LINGUIST
Your ability to learn new languages is unsurpassed. 
Prerequisites Linguistics 5 ranks 
You gain an additional language for every 5 ranks you have in the Linguistics skill (in addition to the one you normally get for every 5 ranks). 
MAGICAL CRAFTING
Making items from magic is an art which you have developed.
Prerequisites Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion 2 ranks, BSB +2
You may use the Create (Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion) action to make permanent magical items. This allows you to create specific magical items and craft runes for armour, shields and weapons. You may add the formula for any one level 2 magical item or rune when you select this feat.
MAGICAL DISCOVERY 
You have unlocked the secrets of a new spell or gain an additional slot to memorise a spell in. 
Prerequisites BSB +2
If you are an instinctive caster, you may learn an additional spell and add it to your repertoire. If you are a learned caster, you gain an additional spell memorised slot each day.
You may select this feat multiple times but never more than once every two levels.
MASTERFUL BURGLAR 
ADVANTAGE 
You have substantial expertise in the arts of breaking, entering and making off with other people’s property. 
Prerequisites Thievery 6 ranks
You gain advantage on all Disable and Pick a Lock (Thievery) checks.
MASTERFUL CRAFTER 
You can construct things more quickly than most. 
Prerequisites Crafting 10 ranks, Specialist Crafter
When you craft a particular kind of item which is covered by your Specialist Crafter feat, the amount of work that you complete in the given timescale is doubled.
METAMAGIC TRAINING
You have unlocked the secrets of a magical warping option. 
You can select any one Metamagic (Class) feat. You do not have to be an Adept to select this feat, but you cannot select a feat that has a specific class trait.
METTLE
Harsh conditions or long exertions do not easily tire you. 
Prerequisites Con +2
You gain a +4-class bonus to any checks made to resist fatigue, exhaustion or environmental effects.
MOMENT OF CLARITY
You clear your rage and anger for the briefest of moments.
Prerequisites Mental Focus 5 ranks, Frenzy
Action 1 AP 
You focus your mind allowing you to use actions with the concentrate trait, regardless of whether they possess the rage trait or not until the end of your turn.
MYSTICAL CONDUIT
Your body responds well to magical healing. 
Prerequisites Con +1
When you regain Hit Points from a magical effect or potion you regain an additional amount of Hit Points equal to half your caster level.
Be aware that you may only benefit from this feat once per casting of a spell.
NATURAL LEADER
ADVANTAGE 
People seem to follow your lead; it has always been that way. 
Prerequisites Diplomacy 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Command and Rally (Diplomacy) checks.
NATURAL MEDICINE
Your healing skills are far older than those of the priests around you. 
Prerequisites Survival 1 rank
Your knowledge of natural cures allows you to use Survival instead of Medicine to Treat Wounds. When in the wilderness, your familiarity with the surroundings grants you a +2-circumstance bonus to your Treat Wounds check using Survival (subject to GM approval).
OCCULT INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE 
Your mind is different and adapts to unusual knowledge and experiences. 
Prerequisites Occultism & Mental Focus 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Recall Knowledge (Occultism) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain an additional piece of information relating to the subject (GM discretion).
ODDITY ASSESSMENT
ADVANTAGE 
You have an instinct for locating strange magic. 
Prerequisites Occultism 1 rank
You gain advantage to all checks made to Identify Magic or Sense Magic with the mental, possession, prediction, or scrying traits.

Prerequisites Perform 5 ranks
You may select an additional Perform Specialty. 
You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a new perform specialty.
PHYSICAL TRAINING
You excel far beyond others at acts of physical prowess. 
Prerequisites Athletics 1 rank
You gain a +1-class bonus to the Athletics skill and Fortitude saving throws.
PHYSICIAN
You have a gift for healing both magical and mundane. 
Prerequisites Medicine 1 rank, BSB +1
You gain a +1-class bonus on Medicine checks and to Spellcraft checks made when casting a spell with the healing trait.
PLANAR INSIGHT
ADVANTAGE 
You understand things that you perhaps shouldn’t.. 
Prerequisites Planes 1 rank
You gain advantage on all Recall Knowledge (Planes) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain an additional piece of information relating to the subject (GM discretion).
PROFESSIONAL SPECIALIST
You have learnt a new specialty.
You may select a new Specialist Skill. 
You may select this feat multiple times, but never more than your INT +1.
QUESTIONABLE SOURCE
You possess a wealth of knowledge, although not all of it originates from reputable or reliable sources. 
Prerequisites One skill with the Recall Knowledge action 1 rank When you make a Recall Knowledge check (using any skill), you always gain a piece of information about the target of your check that is true (although not necessarily useful). 
QUICK CLIMBER
Your climbing ability has become almost spiderlike. 
Prerequisites Climbing 12 ranks
You gain a climb speed equal to half your land speed.
QUICK DONNING
CONCENTRATE MANIPULATE
Prerequisites Athletics 1 rank, Warfare
Having served alongside armoured warriors, you have become skilled in assisting yourself and others with the donning of heavy gear. You can attempt a DC 20 Athletics or Warfare check to try and remove armour with greater haste. Success in this check allows you to significantly reduce the time required for you or an ally to don or remove their armour.
Critical It takes 2 rounds to don light armour, 1 minute to don medium or heavy armour, and 2 rounds to remove any armour. 
Success It takes 5 rounds to don light armour, 2 minutes to don medium or heavy armour, and 5 rounds to remove any armour.
Fumble You are all hands and no fingers. It takes twice the usual time to don or remove the armour. 
QUICK IDENTIFICATION
You can Identify Power swiftly. 
Prerequisites BSB +4
When identifying magical items using Identify Power, you apply the following modifiers; 10 minutes (+2), 1 minute (+0), 1 round (-2), 1 AP (-5), 0 AP (-10).
QUICK RECOVERY
You heal quickly and recover from affliction much faster than others. 
Prerequisites Con +2
You regain double the amount of Hit Points when resting.
Furthermore, when making saving throws against disease or poison, you treat the result of the saving throw as one degree higher. 
Finally, when you rest for a full night, the severity of any Soul Drain reduces by 10, compared to the standard reduction of 5.
QUICK SWIMMER
You move through the water with the grace of a shark. 
Prerequisites Athletics 12 ranks
You gain a swim speed equal to half your land speed.
SCHOOLED IN SECRETS
You have a knack for obtaining information about cults and religious groups.
Prerequisites Religion 1 rank
When you make a Gather Information check to obtain knowledge about cults or religious groups, you may instead use your Religion skill instead of Diplomacy.
SCRIBE SCROLL
You can create magical scrolls.
Prerequisites Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion 1 rank, BSB +1
You may use the Create (Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion) action to scribe magical scrolls. To make a scroll, you must have access to the spell that you are scribing.

ADVANTAGE

You may use the Sense Motive skill to sense the presence of magical auras as if you were using the Power Manipulation skill.

Prerequisites Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion 1 rank
Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within line-of-sight casts a spell.
You can make an appropriate skill check to identify the spell as it is cast. If it is a spell that is in your repertoire, the DC to identify it is reduced by 2.
Critical You identify the incoming spell and gain a +2-circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your DB against it.
Success You identify the incoming spell and gain a +1-circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your DB against it.
Failure You fail to recognize the spell.

You can use your Culture modifier instead of your Diplomacy modifier to Gather Information. Furthermore, you gain a +1-class bonus to all Stealth checks whilst in an urban environment.

You gain a +2-class bonus to any Recall Knowledge checks made to recall the details of things that you have witnessed personally. Furthermore, you may store an additional 2 targets.

You gain Advantage to all Balance (Acrobatics) checks that you make. 
SURVEY WILDLIFE
You can pick up on signs of nearby creatures in a wilderness environment. 
Prerequisites Nature & Survival 2 ranks
By dedicating 10 minutes to surveying your surroundings, you can analyse the area for signs of nearby creatures, such as nests, scat, and marks on vegetation. Make a Survival check, with the DC determined by the GM based on the visibility of the signs. If you succeed, you may then make a Recall Knowledge check, albeit with a -2-circumstance penalty, to glean further information about the creatures solely from these indicators.

THROW ANYTHING
Anything within your grasp can be launched as a weapon at your foes. 
You suffer no penalties for using an improvised thrown weapon. Furthermore, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to attack with any thrown weapon.
TOUGHNESS

Prerequisites BAB +4

Although you have very little skill in the wilderness, tracks and hunting people you know.

You may use your Perception skill at -2 to make Cover Tracks and Track checks instead of the Survival skill.
USE MAGIC DEVICE
You can have a go at activating magic items, even if you are not otherwise trained in their use.
You can use magic items from a magical tradition that you do not have access to. 
VISIONS
You receive spontaneous visions when touching items or creatures.
Prerequisites Meditation & Sense Motive 2 ranks, BSB +4
When touching an object or creature with your bare skin, you may make a Meditation check to receive a vision regarding a significant event in either its past or future. The amount of time that the check takes and the DC is determined by the GM. Once this ability is used, the target is immune for 24 hours. An unwilling target may make a level based Will save to resist its effects.
WEAPON FINESSE 
When a fight breaks out, you prefer swift, lightweight weapons, and you strike where it hurts.

When you attack with a finesse melee weapon, you can add your Dex to damage rolls instead of Str.
